title: AIP Adverse Media Grounded Summary
description: Structured-output schema enforced on every AIP adverse_media_summary response. Validation failure = output rejected; the AIP Function retries with the schema-violation error message included in the next user turn.

summary_text.description: 200-word synthesis (max ~1800 characters). Empty allowed only if insufficient_corpus = true.

factual_assertions.description: Every factual claim in summary_text must appear here with an explicit source. Substring-matched against the cited article by citation_check.py.

assertion.description: The factual claim, restated from the source. May paraphrase.

source_article_id.description: Identifier of the source article (must exist in the news_corpus input).

source_passage.description: VERBATIM substring of the source article that supports the assertion. Citation-check enforces this is a true substring (post-whitespace-normalization).

rating_pressure_direction.description: Advisory signal for review-queue prioritization. Does not drive automated rating changes.

rating_pressure_strength.description: Advisory strength. Combined with direction, drives review-queue ordering only.

insufficient_corpus.description: True when the corpus is too thin to produce a meaningful summary. Setting this true is the CORRECT output for thin-corpus counterparties; producing plausible-but-empty text instead is the failure mode this field exists to prevent.

items_flagged_for_human_review.description: Ambiguous claims requiring analyst judgment. Workshop review-queue consumes this array directly.
